definitions.gloss: to worsen; to deteriorate; to get worse
definitions.explanation: For a condition, situation, or relationship to become worse over time.

examples.japanese: {症状|しょうじょう}が{悪化|あっか}した。
{天候|てんこう}が{悪化|あっか}して、{試合|しあい}が{中止|ちゅうし}になった。
examples.english: The weather deteriorated and the game was canceled.

examples.japanese: {治療|ちりょう}をしないと、{病状|びょうじょう}がさらに{悪化|あっか}する{恐|おそ}れがある。
examples.english: Without treatment, there is a risk that the condition will deteriorate further.

notes: An intransitive verb — the subject worsens on its own. To say someone made something worse (transitive), use {悪化|あっか}させる. Commonly used with health ({症状|しょうじょう}が{悪化|あっか}する), weather ({天気|てんき}が{悪化|あっか}する), relationships ({関係|かんけい}が{悪化|あっか}する), and economic conditions ({景気|けいき}が{悪化|あっか}する). The antonym is {改善|かいぜん}する (to improve).
